evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 8 semesters
Register and complete the online application form on our application portal: John von Neumann University - Apply Online.

notes: The programme page states an entrance examination (oral, online) and a B2 minimum language level; both quotes come from the Studyfinder programme page for this programme (Tourism and Catering, 8 semesters, English, John von Neumann University). The EUR 3,000 per semester fee is stated in the institution's tuition overview table for the Tourism and Catering BSc programme; it applies to self-financed students. No application deadline for non-EU/foreign-qualification applicants with an explicit year was found; the tuition page's '30 July' deadline states no year and does not specify the applicant group, so it was left out. The application channel is the university's own online application portal ('John von Neumann University - Apply Online'); the Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship is a separate route and is not the self-financed admission route.

note.fr: Un entretien en ligne et un examen d'entrée oral font partie de la sélection ; les candidats retenus reçoivent une lettre d'acceptation conditionnelle.
note.en: An online interview and an oral entrance examination are part of the selection; successful applicants receive a conditional acceptance letter.

evidence.quote: The applicant takes part in a professional entrance examination led by the admission committee of the faculty, which makes a recommendation about the admission of the applicant.
